blindSummary:
In July 2024, a 40-year-old person was found dead in a cemetery in this state/province after an alleged kidnapping and rape in a nearby district; three suspects were identified. This is one of the six killings in the 2024–2025 national series. No protective ordinance, institutional hostility finding, or enforcement pattern specific to trans visitors was documented here beyond this single incident.

Net effect: a modest negative deviation from the national baseline. The kidnapping-plus-rape-plus-murder sequence is severe in manner, but the rapid identification of three suspects and the absence of any patterned regional signal (compared, for instance, to the commercial sex-economy structure in a neighbouring state/province) keep the deviation modest. Compare another state/province, where the killing was a targeted assassination explicitly condemned by the national human-rights commission with the word "impunity" and no protective counterweight.
